answer:
Verdict: no

Over the whole trace (0–30,687.7 ms), ticker’s sampler thread stayed steady: its cycle length was 2.000 ms in both the first and last tenth. CPU work per cycle was also steady—0.254 ms in the first tenth and 0.253 ms in the last. So it was not measurably slower by the end.

There were 5 longer cycles out of 14,984; the longest was 31.596 ms. These are isolated outliers, not a trend. The trace does not include the requested sleep interval, so it cannot show lateness relative to the intended schedule.
